title: 第3章 流阴之地第4章 魔鬼文明古莱茵
slug: 从衔尾蛇石碑开始超凡
lines: 黑色文字出现在眼前，有种缓慢流动的质感。
林野在心头默念。
黑色文字消失，他的视线落在手背上，丰碑出现，第三项解锁条件显示‘已完成’。
想了想，他把手中的日记本放下。
‘已完成’的字样没有变化。
又拿起另一本封皮上有字的棕皮书翻看，这本棕皮书只有不到十页。
全部都是手写，也是那种怪异符号文字。
除此之外还手绘了一些植物和动物图案，非常写实清晰。
暗暗点头，房间里有电脑，或许可以通过上面的图案查询到相关信息。
而且这些图案中的几个，他隐约有点印象，原身的记忆里好像在哪见过。
‘解锁成就。’
他在心间默念。
下一刻，周围场景像是陷入了静止。
黑色雾气从手背上的衔尾蛇印记上涌出，沿着手臂向上蔓延。
一股阴凉感觉随之从手臂蔓延向全身，很舒服。
没多久，阴凉气流渐渐消失，林野忍不住呼出一口气。
手背上，黑色衔尾蛇印记微微发亮。
周围场景变幻，他心头一惊，抬手抓向书桌上的那本日记。
但还没碰到，一阵天旋地转，周围的一切已经变回了一开始的房间。
“小野？”
一道略显疲惫的声音传入耳中，林野回过神来，看向前方客厅沙发上坐着的‘母亲’江微澜。
虽然已经年过四十，但看上去要年轻许多，也才三十出头的样子。
只不过现在眼睛有些泛红，神情有些落寞。
手里拿着手机，似乎正要打电话。
他应了一声，心头莫名有些紧张。
江微澜笑了笑，只以为儿子是因为学费的事发愁。
“不用担心，咱家还有些积蓄的。”
林野微微点头，“要不办个助学贷吧。”
母亲只是个银行普通职员，虽然福利不错，但到手工资并不算多。
供着姐姐和他，早年的积蓄也见底了。
content_en:
The black text appears in front of you, with a slow flowing texture.
'no. ’
Lin Ye thought silently in his heart.
The black text disappeared, his eyes fell on the back of his hand, the monument appeared, and the third unlocking condition showed 'Completed'.
After thinking for a while, he put down the diary in his hand.
The words ‘Completed’ remain unchanged.
He picked up another brown book with writing on the cover and flipped through it. This brown book only had less than ten pages.
It's all handwritten, with weird symbols.
In addition, some plant and animal patterns are hand-painted, which are very realistic and clear.
Nodding secretly, there is a computer in the room. You may be able to find relevant information through the patterns on it.
Moreover, he had a vague impression of several of these patterns, as if he had seen them somewhere in his original memory.
‘Unlock achievements. ’
He thought silently in his heart.
The next moment, the surrounding scene seemed to fall into stillness.
Black mist surged from the Ouroboros mark on the back of the hand and spread up the arm.
A cool feeling spread from the arms to the whole body, which was very comfortable.
Not long after, the cool air gradually disappeared, and Lin Ye couldn't help but exhale.
On the back of the hand, the black Ouroboros mark shines slightly.
The scene around him changed, and he was startled. He raised his hand and grabbed the diary on the desk.
But before he touched it, the world started to spin, and everything around him had changed back to the room from the beginning.
"Ono?"
A slightly tired voice reached his ears, and Lin Ye came back to his senses and looked at his 'mother' Jiang Weilan sitting on the sofa in the living room in front of him.
Although he is over forty, he looks much younger, only in his early thirties.
But now his eyes are a little red and his expression is a little lonely.
He had a mobile phone in his hand and seemed about to make a call.
"Mom."
He responded, feeling inexplicably nervous.
Jiang Weilan smiled, thinking that her son was worried about tuition fees.
"Don't worry, our family still has some savings."
Lin Ye nodded slightly, "How about applying for a student loan."
My mother is just an ordinary bank employee. Although the benefits are good, the salary she receives is not much.
To provide for his sister and him, all his early savings were exhausted.
